basic_details.job_title: Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 6,843 Anganwadi Worker and Helper Posts
basic_details.department: Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat

age_limit.details: The candidate must have completed 18 years and must not have crossed the applicable maximum age on the final date for submitting the application.

qualification.education_qualification: Class 10 or Class 12, depending on the post
qualification.details: Women possessing higher educational qualifications may also apply. Selection will be based on the prescribed merit criteria, including educational qualifications and marks.

selection_process: Selection will be made through a merit list prepared according to the applicable recruitment rules. The merit list will consider the candidate's educational qualification and marks.

A separate online merit list will be prepared for each Anganwadi centre. Existing Anganwadi Helpers applying for Worker posts may receive preference according to the applicable Women and Child Development Department rules.
how_to_apply: Visit the Gujarat e-HRMS website at e-hrms.gujarat.gov.in.
Open the Women and Child Development Department advertisement section.
Select the Anganwadi Worker and Helper Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
Read the district notification and common applicant instructions.
Choose the relevant Anganwadi centre and post.
Enter the required personal, educational and residence details.
Upload clear scanned copies of all applicable certificates.
Verify that the entered information matches the uploaded documents.
Submit the online application before the deadline.
Save the submitted application details for future reference.
important_instructions: Only eligible local women can apply for these honorary positions. The information entered in the application must match the uploaded documents. Unreadable, incomplete or incorrect documents may lead to rejection. Candidates with grade or score-based marksheets must upload the official marks or percentage conversion document. Candidates who passed an examination in more than one attempt must upload the original marksheet for each attempt. Applicants must satisfy all eligibility conditions on the last application date. The appointment process will be governed by the applicable Gujarat Women and Child Development Department rules and subsequent amendments.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by the Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat for filling Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts across the state.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6,843 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper vacancies are available under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible female candidates who satisfy the local residence requirements can apply for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Anganwadi Worker, candidates must have passed Class 12 or Class 10 with a recognised diploma course of at least two years. For Anganwadi Helper, candidates must have passed Class 10.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for Anganwadi Worker and Helper applicants is 18 to 33 years. Serving Anganwadi Helpers applying for Worker posts can have a maximum age limit of 43 years as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the Gujarat e-HRMS portal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026 up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared according to the prescribed recruitment rules, considering educational qualifications and marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the honorarium for Gujarat Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: Selected Anganwadi Workers will receive Rs. 10,000 per month, while Anganwadi Helpers will receive Rs. 5,500 per month as honorarium.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Gujarat e-HRMS official website by selecting the Anganwadi Worker and Helper Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
